name: phum-yeung-e-restaurant
description: Phum Yeung Restaurant - Full Stack E-Restaurant

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix admin install && npm --prefix backend install
